question: Alternatives to testing the DP filter on every batch.
number: GROUPED FILTER: AND the 16 flag words u_i = z0_i + REP*0xFFFFFFFF of one unrolled body, then one AND with BIT32REP, one compare, one branch: 16 adds + 15 ands + 1 + 2 = 34 ops per body instead of 64. Per body 9557 against 9587 ops: delta -0.004496 bit (U=16), -0.004615 bit (U=19). Stage-2 then recomputes the body from its 8 preserved inputs: 16 x 595 extra ops per event costs 5e-8 relative (delta -0.004496 including it). Logic tested: 200,000 random packed groups (k=2,4,16, zeros planted), 0 mismatches against 'some lane low 32 bits zero'. Registers: 25 + 8 preserved + 1 accumulator = 34 with immediates; without immediates (constants in registers) 56 for zero spills (Belady), 48 gives 4 stores.
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|MACHINE.CMPBR|MACHINE|Q4. NOT built end to end: only the filter logic and the ledger arithmetic are tested.
